claims: As of April 2026, NASA has not yet announced the specific crewmembers for the Artemis III mission.
The Artemis III mission is currently planned for a 2027 launch.
The Artemis III mission is planned to test docking in low Earth orbit.
The Artemis III mission will fly on a Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Artemis III mission will rendezvous with a commercial lunar lander (Starship or Blue Moon).
The Artemis III mission will focus on testing rendezvous and docking capabilities between the Orion spacecraft and human landing systems in Earth orbit.
Artemis II is the immediate prior mission to Artemis III.
Artemis II will orbit the Moon in early 2026.
The Artemis II crew includes Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis III will test the SpaceX Starship or Blue Moon lander with the Axiom Extravehicular Mobility Unit (AxEMU) space suits.
